help.intro: A five-minute checkpoint on the first half of this module, run in your own AI assistant with voice on: what you have, what you need today, and whose things they are. Copy the exercise in, switch on voice, say 'Los geht's'. The tutor listens for two things: the accusative after haben and brauchen — einen Apfel, einen Stift, keinen Hund — and the possessive with its ending — mein Auto, meine Tasche, meinen Schlüssel. Answer in full sentences; the score is on the article and the ending, which only show up in a sentence.
help.tips[0].title: haben and brauchen want the accusative
help.tips[0].examples[0].en: What do you need? – I need a coffee and my key.
help.tips[0].examples[1].en: Do you have a brother? – No, I don't have a brother.
help.tips[0].check.q: Was brauchst du heute? – Ich brauche ____ Regenschirm. (der Regenschirm)
help.tips[0].check.why: brauchen takes the accusative, and a masculine object gets -en: einen Regenschirm.
help.tips[1].title: Say the possessive with the noun
help.tips[1].text: Wessen Tasche ist das? – Das ist meine Tasche. The ending shows you know the gender.
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: That's my car, and that's my flat.
help.tips[1].check.q: Wessen Jacke ist das? (die Jacke) – Das ist ____ Jacke.
help.tips[1].check.why: Jacke is feminine, so the possessive takes -e: meine Jacke.
help.remember[0]: Blue nouns get -en after haben / brauchen: einen, keinen, meinen.
help.remember[1]: Whole sentences — the ending is the point, and it only lives in a sentence.
help.hook: Talk for three minutes about what you have, what you need and whose it is — einen Stift, meinen Schlüssel, meine Tasche.
speaking.topic: What I have and what I need today, and whose things they are.
speaking.practisePoints[0]: Accusative objects after haben and brauchen: einen Stift, eine Tasche
speaking.practisePoints[1]: Possessives with their ending: mein Auto, meine Tasche, meinen Schlüssel
speaking.practisePoints[2]: Negation with kein: Ich habe keinen Hund, keine Zeit
speaking.scoringCriteria[2]: a full sentence with the object in it (Ich habe einen Stift), not just the noun
speaking.material: Ask me what is in my bag or on my desk right now (Was hast du in deiner Tasche?), what I need today (Was brauchst du heute?), what I do not have (Hast du einen Hund?), and whose things they are (Ist das dein Handy? Wessen Schlüssel ist das?). At least two questions where my answer needs mein-/dein- with an ending.
